description: Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Commercial feedback has five unclassified sources and no new interpreted feedback, so buyer demand remains unknown. The SQLite referral packet and patch match their recorded hashes. The inspected records leave independent readiness and operator authorization unresolved. In parallel, test whether an original French municipal procurement notice supports a separately priced offline inventory reconciliation deliverable. This test uses public sources and existing tools. Any submission depends on the buyer’s published terms and operator authorization, and any public deployment retains host-enforced independent review.
